name: vav
description: Local-first agent workbench: open files, ask and edit beside them, and run VAV or Claude/Codex in the same thread — with a real terminal on the side.
author: Oboo Cheng

scripts.dist: node scripts/fetch-officecli.mjs --target darwin-arm64 --clean && node scripts/build-tailcat-sidecar.mjs --target darwin-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-officecli.mjs --target win32-x64 --clean && node scripts/build-tailcat-sidecar.mjs --target win32-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.release: node scripts/fetch-officecli.mjs --target darwin-arm64 --clean && node scripts/build-tailcat-sidecar.mjs --target darwin-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --publish always

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: VAV pairs with other computers and phones on your local network to open folders and run agents.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: VAV hides its windows so you can capture the screen, annotate the image, and attach it to a conversation.
